verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS platform with SDKs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented setting, flag or policy that lets a user turn off Hightouch's own telemetry or usage tracking. The Events SDKs and Tracking API are tools customers use to track their own end users, and the warehouse-native architecture is about data storage; neither is a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
